page0.text:
It's clear who the enemy is.
If Caster is attacking with an entire army, there's only one thing for us to do.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page0:1

page1.text:
"Us staying here won't do anything. Saber, come with me. Tohsaka, you take Illya."
"What!? Why!? I don't want to babysit Rin!"
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page1:1

page2.text: "That's my line! And I thought you said you were going to listen to Shirou. He's telling you to stay back, so no arguing."
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page2:1

page3.text:
"I don't care!
I'm more useful than Saber—"
Tohsaka grabs Illya from behind in a full nelson and covers her mouth.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page3:1

page4.text:
"Mmmnnngh! Mnnngh!!! Nnnngh!!!"
Illya, her voice muffled, continues shouting insults and expletives.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page4:1

page5.text: "Got it. I'll protect Illya. I'm counting on you to defeat Caster."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page5:1

page6.text:
"Thanks. But try not to overdo it. You're better off running than fighting, if it comes to it."
Tohsaka nods, as if to say she doesn't have to be reminded.
I turn my back to Tohsaka and head toward the veranda.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page6:1

page7.text:
"Saber."
"Yes, I know. I will take care of Shirou."
Saber follows me after nodding to Tohsaka.
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page7:1

page8.text:
In that instant.
I doubt my own eyes.
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page8:1

page9.text:
A sword swings down at me.
I stand, stunned, as the blade descends toward my head.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page9:1

page10.text:
"...Acgk!"
I twist away and parry with my wooden sword.
Even I don't believe it.
My body just reacted the instant I knew I was in mortal peril.
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page10:1

page11.text:
The enemy attacks again without missing a beat.
A smooth, mechanical movement.
A fluid, accurate attack.
But that's it.
It's accurate, but it's not sophisticated, and it lacks the brutality of a killing strike.
It seems pathetic next to the strength of Saber's strikes, like it's barely moving in comparison to Berserker's incredible speed.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page11:1

page12.text:
...
Back against the wall, I parry again.
As I step back against the wall...
Saber strikes like lightning.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page12:1

page13.text:
"Shirou, are you all right?"
"See for yourself. I got a little spooked, but I managed."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page13:1

page14.text:
""That will not do. At times like this, you must stand behind me. Please be more careful."
Saber scolds me for my carelessness.
She's right, but I didn't want to just stay behind her.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page14:1

page15.text:
"Shirou? Are you listening?"
"I am. So, Saber...what was that thing?"
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page15:1

page16.text:
The hallway is empty.
Whatever hideous thing Saber saved me from was completely annihilated by her attack.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page16:1

page17.text: "It was exactly as Illyasviel said... It was a soldier made by using a monster's body as a catalyst. It seems more like a golem than an automaton, but seemed to be of low quality. I will have no trouble defeating them, even if we are surrounded."
page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page17:1

page18.text:
"Gh—!?"
I don't know where they were hiding... How the hell many did they manage to sneak in?
These crudely assembled...things scuttle all around us, closing in like spiders.
But they're not the only presence I sense.
Countless others surround the house, many times more than I see here.
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page18:1

page19.text:
"Shirou, next to you!"
"Hngh!"
I leap away from the wall.
"Kngh... Why you!"
I strike at the bones with my wooden sword.
Saber sweeps away the bones crawling toward my exposed back.
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page19:1

page20.text:
The bones move jerkily toward us, attacking with the same unnatural movements.
It's not hard to fight them off, but we're destroying more of the house with every strike.
And I only have a wooden sword.
Even if I use Strengthening on it, it won't last.
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page20:1

page21.text:
As much as I hope I'm wrong, it seems like the bones heading for us are endless.
I really hope this isn't going to go on until we both collapse from exhaustion.
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page21:1

page22.text:
"Damn. Where are these things coming from!?"
I can't help but complain as I fight back-to-back with Saber.
There aren't that many bones coming at me.
Some seem to be coming from inside the house, but most seem to be coming from the yard.
Saber is slashing away at the bones coming from the yard.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page22:1

page23.text:
It looks like they're heading towards the living room.
Tohsaka and Illya are in there, and Saber has her hands full dealing with the bones heading that way.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page23:1

page24.text:
...
Saber readies her sword.
There may be no need to hide it now. Her golden sword is ready to demonstrate its true power.
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page24:1

page25.text:
"W-wait Saber! Don't use Excalibur right now! I don't care if you destroy the house—okay I might care a little, but we're in a residential area. You know what'll happen if you use it here!"
I shout to Saber as I bat away the bones striking at me.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page25:1

page26.text:
"I will obey your order, but dealing with so many enemies at once is not ideal. We could find ourselves in trouble if we do not sweep them all aside in a single blow."
"I know. These things are like familiars, right? Then if we defeat the one who's controlling them, that should wipe out the whole army. Saber, can you find Caster?"
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page26:1

page27.text:
"There's no need. Caster is in the yard.
She is not concealing herself, which tells me she hopes to lure us to her."
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page27:1

page28.text:
"Fine. Let's give her what she wants. We aren't going to last like this."
"I do not mind, but are you saying we are going to attack Caster there?"
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page28:1

page29.text:
...
The yard is just ahead.
If Caster's just out there, she shouldn't be too difficult to reach.
page29.sourceUnit: セイバールート十三日目-02:page29:1
